title: Austin Government Streamlining
meeting_type: Council Transition Work Group Regular Meeting
summary:
*   City leaders discussed ways to improve their internal operational procedures and processes.
*   They reviewed a draft report detailing the city's recent transition efforts.
*   Discussions focused on potentially reorganizing how the city's committees are structured.
